Crawl with browser mode 'auto' falls back to browser when encountering WAF 403

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { BrowserMode, crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { mode: BrowserMode.Auto }, maxDepth: 1, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.pages?.length);
}

void main();
```
